mapper.sql: instrument_id, trade_date, open, high, low, close, pre_close, volume, amount, pct_chg, turnover_rate, adj_type, source
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO daily_bar (instrument_id, trade_date, open, high, low, close, pre_close, volume, amount, pct_chg, turnover_rate, adj_type, source, fetched_at, data_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{it.instrumentId}, #{it.tradeDate}, #{it.open}, #{it.high}, #{it.low}, #{it.close}, #{it.preClose}, #{it.volume}, #{it.amount}, #{it.pctChg}, #{it.turnoverRate}, #{it.adjType}, #{it.source}, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'), 'ACCEPTED', strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'))
ON CONFLICT (instrument_id, trade_date) DO UPDATE SET open = excluded.open, high = excluded.high, low = excluded.low, close = excluded.close, pre_close = excluded.pre_close, volume = excluded.volume, amount = excluded.amount, pct_chg = excluded.pct_chg, turnover_rate = excluded.turnover_rate, adj_type = excluded.adj_type, source = excluded.source, fetched_at = excluded.fetched_at, data_status = excluded.data_status, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM daily_bar WHERE instrument_id = #{instrumentId}
SELECT MIN(trade_date) FROM daily_bar WHERE instrument_id = #{instrumentId}
SELECT DISTINCT trade_date FROM daily_bar WHERE instrument_id = #{instrumentId} ORDER BY trade_date
SELECT DISTINCT trade_date FROM daily_bar ORDER BY trade_date
SELECT instrument_id, COUNT(*) AS bar_count, MIN(trade_date) AS first_trade_date, MAX(trade_date) AS last_trade_date FROM daily_bar GROUP BY instrument_id
SELECT instrument_id, MIN(trade_date) AS first_date FROM daily_bar GROUP BY instrument_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daily_bar WHERE instrument_id = #{instrumentId}
